source: ERCOT market notices: Notification of Suspension of Operations (NSO), Nov 2023 to Nov 2026, plus follow-up notices and the owner's own filings where noted
note: An NSO is the notice a plant owner must give ERCOT before retiring (decommission), mothballing (indefinite suspension) or temporarily suspending a unit. ERCOT then decides whether the unit is needed for reliability (if so it can keep it running under a Reliability Must-Run contract). Units under 2.5 MW (NRG TOSBATT_UNIT1, Hoefs Road battery) are left out.
